definition: מָסַךְ verb mix, produce by mixing (compare perhaps מזג , מֶזֶג Ba ES 33, 51 ); — Qal Perfect 3 masculine singular ׳ מ Isa 19:14 מָֽסְכָה Prov 9:2 מָסָ֑כְתִּי Prov 9:5 ; Ps 102:10 Infinitive construct מְסֹךְ Isa 5:22 — 1. pour , only figurative, בְּקִרְבָּהּ ׳ מ רוּחַ עִוְעִים Isa 19:14 (subject ׳ מ ); mix , with accusative שֵׁכָר Isa 5:22 i.e. make a choice drink by mixing with spices, etc. (mixing with water came later, compare 2 Macc 15:39) Löw p. 419 Frä 162 f, 171 f. Now Archaeology 1, 120 Benz Archaeology 95 ; object יַיִן figurative, subject wisdom Prov 9:2 ; Prov 9:5 שִׁקֻּוַי בִּבְכִי מָסָ֑כְתִּי Ps 102:10 my drink with weeping have I mixed (see Assyrian [ akâl ] ul âkul, bikîtum kurmati, mê ul aštî, dîmtu maštîtî Zim BP 34 ).
